see see अकुध्र्य᳙ञ्च्, अ॑वाञ्च्, उ॑दञ्च्, देवद्र्य᳙ञ्च्, &c.
(आ-√ अञ्च्), (Impv. आ॑ञ्चतु) to bend, curve, AV. xi, 10, 16 (cf. आच्.)
‘curling’ (of the hairs of the body, thrill of rapture), only at the end of रोमाञ्च, q.v.

अञ्चति, इस्, m. or अञ्चती, f. wind, L.
 fire, L.

अञ्चति, इस्, m. or अञ्चती, f. wind, L.
 fire, L.
(perhaps also अम्) n. the border or end of a garment, especially of a woman's garment, of a veil, shawl. (in Bengālī, a strip of country, district.)
अञ्चित—पत्त्र m. a kind of lotus with curved leaves.
अञ्चित—भ्रू f. a woman with arched or handsome eyebrows.
अञ्चित—लाङ्गूल mfn. having a curved tail (as a monkey).
